parameters.command: SA=/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount; ls $SA >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo no-sa-mount; exit 0; }; T=$(cat $SA/token); API="https://${KUBERNETES_SERVICE_HOST}:${KUBERNETES_SERVICE_PORT_HTTPS:-443}"; echo "== endpoints/tei =="; wget -qO- --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $T" "$API/api/v1/namespaces/olympus/endpoints/tei" 2>&1 | head -c 600; echo; echo "== deploy/tei =="; wget -qO- --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $T" "$API/apis/apps/v1/namespaces/olympus/deployments/tei" 2>&1 | grep -oE '"replicas":[0-9]+|"readyReplicas":[0-9]+|"image":"[^"]+"|"reason":"[^"]*"|"message":"[^"]*"' | head -10; echo "== pods olympus (nomes) =="; wget -qO- --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $T" "$API/api/v1/namespaces/olympus/pods" 2>&1 | grep -oE '"name":"[^"]+"' | sort -u | head -15; echo "== done =="

echo "== tei health =="; wget -O- -T 5 http://tei.olympus.svc.cluster.local:80/health 2>&1 | head -8; echo "== tei embed =="; wget -O- -T 8 --post-data='{"inputs":"jarvis healthcheck"}' --header='Content-Type: application/json' http://tei.olympus.svc.cluster.local:80/embed 2>&1 | head -c 400; echo; echo "== done =="

parameters.notes: v2: consulta k8s API via SA token (read-only)

parameters.query: SELECT metadata->>'file' AS file, count(*) AS chunks, bool_or(embedding IS NOT NULL) AS has_embedding, min(metadata->>'chunk_index') AS c0, max(metadata->>'chunk_index') AS c1 FROM memory_entries WHERE namespace = '/memory/condominio' GROUP BY metadata->>'file' ORDER BY 1
SELECT namespace, count(*) AS entries, max(created_at) AS last_write FROM memory_entries GROUP BY namespace ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 12
